prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted spacing correction for LH07-0107. Image 1 controls original row anatomy. Image 2 is the current landscape candidate to edit. Image 3 controls exact Japanese content, typography and the target layout. Image 4 is approved style guidance. Keep the canvas at the same tight 390:302 landscape ratio as Image 3. At 390px width, match these bounds: one-line question begins at y=25; country row x=20,y=56,w=350,h=70; language row x=20,y=138,w=350,h=71; green 完了 button x=20,y=244,w=350,h=44, ending at y=288 with about14px bottom margin. Image 2 currently has the question about5px too low, row heights about4-5px too short, and the button begins14px too early. Move each part to the stated positions and restore the larger gap between language row and button. Preserve Image 3 exact Meiryo sizes, weights, line heights and wrapping. Do not enlarge or thicken text. Keep exactly these six strings and no others: どの国・地域と言語で利用しますか？; 国・地域; 米国; 言語; 英語; 完了. Keep small US flag before 米国, two separate white outlined rows, right chevrons, fine neutral outlines, slate chevrons and a forest-green action with white text. No toolbar, status/navigation bars, footer, outer card, duplicate controls or decorative effects. Keep the same small white margins as Image 3, with no unused canvas area.
reviewNotes: Matched 390x302 review: correct landscape and content. Question is9px low; rows are5-6px short/misaligned; action is8px short and ends14px too high. Increase the control dimensions and align the question with the reference. Not complete or owner accepted.
